attributes.name: key imagery format
attributes.definition: How the page's main visual content is produced and embedded: real photographs, solid/pastel color blocks, or icon/thumbnail graphics.

values.definition: Real photographs are used for key imagery.
Solid-color or pastel blocks with text overlays replace photography.
Small icons or video thumbnails serve as the visual content.
No key imagery or another treatment.

attributes.name: image embedding method
attributes.definition: How images are placed in the markup.

values.definition: Images are CSS backgrounds, SVG or other non-img means.

attributes.name: image accessibility text
attributes.definition: Whether images/controls carry accessible text or ARIA metadata.

values.definition: ARIA attributes are used for accessibility.
